name: Üröm (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Üröm: a crowned blue and red shield with a bunch of grapes and a crest, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
